text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syria celebrates the golden 50 years anniversary of the establishment of the ruling Baath party.
- Arab League is disappointed at the U.S. position flooding arms to Israel.
- As condemnation of Israeli policies in Middle East peace process, a European meeting will be held to discuss developments.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of a visit to the U.S. stressed commitment to keep building Jewish settlements and is due to meet President Bill Clinton today.
- Syrian Defence Minister Mustafa Tlas says Syria sticks to its conditions of peace with Israel.

- Assad in a spreech published in al-Baath says: "we will not abandon a span of land or one of our national rights. Aggression will fail, the ability of people to sacrifice is unlimited and is the base for victory."
